lead: Every number on this page was recomputed here, in your browser, from Solana devnet accounts and transactions. Qupon's servers are not asked anything.

seal.fail: {n, plural, one {# check failed} other {# checks failed}}
seal.sub: {actions, plural, one {# corporate action} other {# corporate actions}} · {txs, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}

how.title: How this proof works
how.readText: Accounts and transactions come straight from a Solana devnet node. Nothing is asked of Qupon.
how.recomputeText: Every holder's amount with the program's own integer math (half-up per holder), the snapshot fingerprint and the escrow's money in and out.
how.compareText: Each check shows ✓ or ✗ with the numbers behind it, and every transaction opens in the Solana explorer.

notYet: Checks start once the record date passes and the holders are snapshotted.
cancelled: Cancelled before the record date: nothing to verify.

entitlements.title: Every holder's amount recomputed
entitlements.pass: {ok} of {total} holders: gross, tax, net and principal match the program to the smallest unit.
entitlements.fail: {bad} of {total} holders differ from the recomputed amounts.

supply.title: The snapshot covers the whole issue
supply.pass: {units} bonds snapshotted = {supply} in circulation at the record date, rebuilt from every mint and burn.
supply.fail: {units} bonds snapshotted, but {supply} were in circulation at the record date.
supply.pending: The snapshot is not final yet.

hash.title: Snapshot fingerprint matches
hash.pass: The {scheme} recomputed from the holders equals the one the program stored.
hash.fail: The {scheme} recomputed from the holders differs from the one the program stored.

totals.title: Action totals add up
totals.pass: Gross {gross}, tax {tax}, net {net}, principal {principal} across {holders} holders = the sum of the entitlements.
totals.fail: The action's totals differ from the sum of its entitlements: {bad}.

funded.title: Escrow funded in full
funded.pass: {deposited} reached the escrow; {required} is owed to holders and the tax vault.
funded.fail: Only {deposited} reached the escrow of {required} owed.
funded.pending: Not funded yet: {deposited} of {required} in the escrow.

payouts.title: Payouts match the entitlements
payouts.pass: {paidOut} left the escrow in pay transactions = net + principal + tax of the {holders} paid holders.
payouts.fail: {paidOut} left the escrow, but {owed} was owed to the paid holders.
payouts.pending: No holder has been paid yet.

default.title: Default and cure
default.pass: Declared with {balance} of {required} in the escrow, cured {late} later by full funding: the record-date holders were paid.
default.passOpen: Declared with {balance} of {required} in the escrow: the issuer missed the payment date.
default.fail: The default does not match the escrow's ledger.

bank.title: Bank payouts confirmed
bank.pass: {confirmed, plural, one {# payout} other {# payouts}} routed to the paying agent confirmed, {pending} pending. The bank transfer itself is simulated.
bank.fail: {pending} payouts are pending at the paying agent, which does not match the entitlements.

disclosure.title: Disclosure anchored
disclosure.pass: The sha256 of the official notice (seev.031) is recorded on-chain: {hash}.
disclosure.info: No notice hash is anchored for this action.
disclosure.match: Your file matches the anchored hash.
disclosure.differ: Your file's sha256 is {hash}: it is not the anchored notice.

txs.seriesText: Transactions of the series that belong to no single corporate action.

ix.SetPayoutRoute: Payout route set by the holder

scopeText: The same split as on the home page: what this page proves runs on devnet; the rest is labelled.

selfHost.title: Run it yourself
selfHost.text: This page also builds as plain static files that any web host can serve. Point it at your own node to remove us from the picture entirely.

error.title: Devnet could not be read
error.text: {message}. A public node limits requests per second: try again in a minute, or set NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL to your own node.
error.missingTitle: No Qupon series for this mint
error.missingText: Devnet has no Qupon series for {mint}. Check the address or open one of the demo series.
error.badMint: That is not a Solana address

pick.title: Verify a bond series
pick.text: Paste a bond mint address. The page reads devnet directly and checks every corporate action of the series.
